faqs.q: What does MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL do?
faqs.a: We support businesses with practical business, sourcing, digital and online requirements. We understand the requirement, identify what it needs, bring in the right expertise and handle the work through a structured process.

faqs.q: Do you work with international businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. Where the requirement fits our services, we work with businesses inside and outside Bangladesh. We review each requirement individually.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum size of business you work with?
faqs.a: No fixed minimum. What matters is whether the requirement is clear and fits what we do.

faqs.q: What kind of work do you take on?
faqs.a: Our work is organized into six categories: Sourcing & Business Solutions, Digital & Online Solutions, Content & Creative, Marketing & Growth, SEO & Digital Visibility, and Project, Institutional & Partnership Support. These are broad areas rather than a fixed list; if your requirement is related, describe it and we will review it.
Yes. Some work is a single project; some needs continuing support such as content, website updates or search visibility. Where ongoing support is required, we work with businesses over the long term.
No. We do not guarantee sales, followers, leads, rankings, growth or supplier outcomes. We commit to a structured process, the right expertise, honest reporting and follow-through.
You do. Whether it is a supplier, a design or a piece of content, we organise the options and the information behind them so you can decide with confidence.

Seven steps: understand, research, plan, source or build, coordinate, review, and deliver & support. The same steps apply to websites, content, marketing, SEO, sourcing and project work. The Our Process page explains each one.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: A clear description of what you need, the quantity, any quality standard and your timeline. Drawings, photos or reference links help.

faqs.q: Will I have one point of contact?
faqs.a: Yes. Each requirement has one point of contact on our side, so you always know who to ask.

faqs.q: How often will I get updates?
faqs.a: We agree an update rhythm with you at the start, and contact you sooner whenever something needs your decision.

faqs.q: How do I request a service?
faqs.a: Use the Request a Service form. Our team reviews each request and contacts you by email or phone.

faqs.q: Does sending a request commit me to anything?
faqs.a: No. A request starts a conversation. Any work is agreed separately and in writing.

faqs.q: Can I attach files to my request?
faqs.a: Yes. You can attach one PDF, image or document of up to 5 MB, such as a specification or reference photo.
